title: Chat Widget
description: A super-lightweight, open-source GPT-powered chatbot you can drop into any static site in seconds. Zero-config embed with just two `<script>` tags, serverless Netlify Function backend to proxy OpenAI calls, fully customizable UI, MIT-licensed, and supports per-user routes and analytics integrations.
